versions.content: If FULL_COMMUNICATION is requested the Ethernet Interface Controller is set to the state ACTIVE. To reach FULL_COMMUNICATION it is also necessary to get an ACTIVE link state (Ethernet cable is connected) and an ONLINE TcpIP state (IP communication is available). The link state will be detected by the Ethernet Transceiver module and will be communicated by the Ethernet Interface. The TcpIP state will be detected and communicated by the TcpIp module.
